title: Ringsend
html_source: This would be Ringsend’s Great South Wall.

anchor.prefix: ms slowed, shunted, changed trolley, started for Blackrock, Kingstown and Dalkey, Clonskea, Rathgar and Terenure, Palmerston Park and upper Rathmines, Sandymount Green, Rathmines,
anchor.suffix:
and Sandymount Tower, Harold's Cross. The hoarse Dublin United Tramway Company's timekeeper bawled them off: 

 — Rathgar and Terenure! 

 — Come on, Sandymount Green!
